scenario: Authenticated Web TS-CORE-01 moves from explicit synthetic localhost submit through exact evidence review, human confirmation with one correction, separate local approval, destination readback, and boundary recovery states.

review_plan.reason: The artifact includes a complete responsive 390 px journey, reflow, motion, keyboard, and automated accessibility evidence.
The artifact changes the core recruiter evidence-review, decision, approval, and recovery workflow.
The artifact presents candidate conversation evidence and controls recruiter interpretation, action, and deletion.
The artifact handles sensitive evidence, provenance, authority, readback, revocation, and deletion while an upstream capture veto remains active.
No assessment, ranking, scorecard, comparison, or validity claim changed in this Web craft round.
The local action and outcome semantics did not introduce a role-performance or win-win hiring claim.
No potential model, longitudinal executive assessment, or potential-trait claim is present.
The artifact exposes evidence and recruiter workflow state but does not make a candidate motivation or selection recommendation.
No sourcing query, search strategy, talent map, or discovery ranking changed.
This is a bounded implementation and evidence adjudication, not a fresh market-signal investigation.

reviews.lens: responsive task completion, reachability, focus, assistive semantics, motion preference, and constrained-layout state truth

findings.criterion: Native zoom and manual screen-reader proof
findings.observation: The complete authenticated journey is directly usable at 390 px, 640 CSS px reflows without overflow under reduced motion, the final production axe scans have zero violations, and keyboard focus reaches each evidence anchor in order. The 640 run is only 200%-equivalent, and the accessibility-tree transcript is automated rather than a manual screen-reader session.
findings.user_impact: Responsive browser users have strong direct coverage, while users relying on native zoom or spoken traversal could still encounter an unobserved reading or announcement defect.
findings.recommendation: Run native 200% browser zoom and one manual VoiceOver or NVDA traversal against the same backend-owned states.
findings.verification: The source, four fact decisions, separate action approval, readback, errors, and recovery remain visible, ordered, focusable, and correctly announced without horizontal scrolling.

findings.observation: Axe reports zero final violations but leaves color-contrast nodes incomplete, and reduced transparency was not directly exercised.
findings.user_impact: The quiet palette is visually coherent in the captured production states, but users with contrast or transparency preferences lack direct manual proof.
findings.recommendation: Perform manual contrast sampling and a reduced-transparency review for critical text, focus outlines, and state callouts.
findings.verification: Every critical label and state indicator meets the intended contrast threshold and remains legible when transparency is reduced.

strengths: The authenticated TS-CORE-01 journey is directly observed at 390 px with no horizontal overflow.
The production screenshot set covers loading, empty, no_action, ambiguity, stale, unknown, recovery, deletion, and revocation without development overlays.
Keyboard Enter on Skip to content moves focus to the single main#main-content target, and the 12-step focus order is deterministic and visibly outlined.
Reduced-motion media emulation reports zero running animations while preserving the complete verified composition.
missing_evidence: Manual VoiceOver, NVDA, or JAWS traversal.
open_questions: Does a smallest-supported desktop browser at native 200% zoom preserve the same efficient decision density as the 640 CSS px equivalence run?

reviews.lens: time-constrained recruiter task completion, evidence inspection, bounded decisions, useful next action, and honest recovery

findings.observation: The production flow makes evidence, four individual fact decisions, one corrected confirmed value, a separately approved local effect, and verified readback visible in order. The evaluator completed the path, but no uncoached recruiter was observed explaining the distinction among confirmation, approval, and outcome.
findings.user_impact: An experienced operator can inspect and complete the work, while a first-time recruiter may still hesitate at the two authority transitions.
findings.recommendation: Run one uncoached recruiter walkthrough and record hesitation, backtracking, and any mistaken outcome claims.
findings.verification: A first-time recruiter completes TS-CORE-01 without prompting and correctly states that fact confirmation creates no effect, approval creates no result, and verified requires readback.

findings.observation: Every declared stale, unknown, revoked, deleted, and offline state is directly reachable and truthfully labeled, but the evidence is a state matrix rather than a timed recruiter session through multiple consecutive failures.
findings.user_impact: Recovery correctness is strong, but the time and cognitive load of repeated exception handling are not measured.
findings.recommendation: Time one recruiter through unknown-result reconciliation followed by an offline refresh and recovery.
findings.verification: The recruiter recovers without duplicate execution, unsafe retry, or confusion about which state remains authoritative.

strengths: The source quote, provenance, proposed facts, decision controls, and smallest next step are visible without agent-style narration or hidden automation.
Editing work mode preference changes the confirmed state while preserving the exact original source beside it.
The approved screen explicitly says that no destination result has been claimed, and verified appears only after readback.
No_action, ambiguity, supersession, stale approval, unknown result, backend failure, deletion, and revocation all expose the appropriate next recruiter decision or terminal boundary.
open_questions: After repeated real use, would recruiters prefer an explicit reviewed-all summary before the separate approval without weakening individual fact decisions?

reviews.lens: human-first handling of candidate evidence, respectful uncertainty, recruiter restraint, reversibility, and avoidance of manufactured urgency

findings.criterion: Live candidate transparency and consent language
findings.observation: The evaluated flow is clearly synthetic, keeps the exact candidate words visible, lets the recruiter edit or dismiss interpretations, creates no candidate contact, and provides deletion lineage. It does not evaluate the notice, consent, retention, or correction language that a live candidate-data deployment would require.
findings.user_impact: The localhost product slice treats the candidate record with restraint, but it does not prove that a live candidate would understand or be able to challenge the use of their conversation.
findings.recommendation: Before any live-data release, evaluate candidate-facing notice, purpose limitation, retention, deletion, and correction routes.
findings.verification: A live-data policy and candidate-facing flow clearly explain what is captured, why, for how long, how it is corrected, and how deletion propagates.

findings.observation: No_action, ambiguity, blocked, and supersession states prevent overconfident or unnecessary action, but no uncoached recruiter study tests whether the copy reliably stops people from reading proposals as facts.
findings.user_impact: The interface language is careful, while actual operator interpretation remains inferred.
findings.recommendation: Ask first-time recruiters to paraphrase proposed, confirmed, dismissed, approved, unknown, and verified states.
findings.verification: Participants do not report a proposal as a candidate fact or an approval as a completed candidate-facing action.

strengths: The product preserves the candidate's exact words and visibly distinguishes them from recruiter-confirmed interpretation.
The corrected work-mode value never overwrites the original source quote.
The action is recruiter-owned, deterministic, and localhost-only; no message, meeting, or candidate-facing write occurs.
No_action avoids manufacturing work, ambiguity remains unresolved, and prohibited participant or source boundaries do not become candidate facts.
Deletion revokes access before removing registered derivatives and leaves a narrow lineage tombstone rather than a readable conversation.
missing_evidence: Candidate-facing notice, correction, retention, and consent evaluation for live data.
Uncoached recruiter paraphrase study for proposal-versus-fact semantics.
open_questions: What live-product language will tell candidates how a recruiter can correct or delete evidence-derived working state?

reviews.lens: intentional capture, provenance, account scope, proposal and authority separation, truthful outcome, revocation, deletion, and reversibility

findings.observation: The Web path is directly authenticated, backend-owned, synthetic, source-linked, and local-only after receipt. This task did not load and invoke the frozen unpacked Chrome extension, prove temporary activeTab or selected-text scope, or prove network silence before explicit Submit.
findings.user_impact: The downstream Web review can be safe while the integrated journey still lacks proof that candidate evidence entered only through the promised visible and least-privilege capture gesture.
findings.recommendation: Run the exact frozen extension in a policy-authorized visible Chrome profile and record permission, preview, pre-Submit network, Submit, and the single scoped receipt.
findings.verification: One direct trace proves no history or background-tab access, no capture request before Submit, one explicit Submit, and one account-scoped synthetic receipt.

findings.criterion: Manual assistive interpretation of evidence authority
findings.observation: The automated accessibility tree exposes source, proposal, confirmed value, action, and verified text, and final axe scans have zero violations. No manual screen-reader session proves that spoken order and state changes preserve these safety boundaries.
findings.user_impact: A screen-reader user could encounter an unobserved announcement-order defect that makes a proposal sound confirmed or an approval sound completed.
findings.recommendation: Run VoiceOver or NVDA through the full decision and recovery path.
findings.verification: Spoken order keeps exact evidence, proposed interpretation, confirmed state, approval, unknown result, and verified readback distinct.

strengths: Every production screenshot uses synthetic TS-CORE-01 evidence in an isolated localhost project; no external write or candidate contact occurs.
The Web surface preserves receipt, source message, proposal, corrected confirmed state, version-bound approval, effect attempt, and destination readback as distinct objects.
Unknown result blocks retry until reconciliation, stale preview invalidates approval, backend failure preserves prior readable state, and capability revocation survives reload to block execution.
Deletion revokes source access before derivative removal and leaves only non-readable lineage.
The missing skip target was recorded as a real before finding, fixed with one focusable main landmark, covered by a regression test, and re-scanned to zero production axe violations.
missing_evidence: Direct loaded-extension invocation and temporary permission trace.
Manual screen-reader traversal of the authority sequence.
vetoes: XS-CAPTURE-01: the intentional Chrome capture and pre-Submit silence boundary is unproven.

top_findings.reason: The Web slice is directly proven after receipt, but the integrated journey still lacks visible unpacked-extension invocation, temporary scope, and pre-Submit silence.
top_findings.next_step: Run the frozen extension in a policy-authorized visible Chrome profile without changing the existing capture rubric.
top_findings.verification: A direct trace proves one intentional scoped synthetic capture, no pre-Submit transfer, and one account-scoped receipt.

top_findings.criterion: Native zoom and manual assistive technology
top_findings.reason: The 390 path, reduced motion, focus order, automated accessibility tree, and zero final axe violations are direct, but native 200% zoom and manual screen-reader behavior remain unproven.
top_findings.next_step: Run native 200% browser zoom and one manual VoiceOver or NVDA traversal against the same backend-owned journey.
top_findings.verification: All evidence, decisions, authority, errors, and recovery remain unclipped, ordered, and truthfully announced.

top_findings.reason: The evaluator completed every production state, but no uncoached first-time recruiter demonstrated the intended authority model.
top_findings.next_step: Run one uncoached recruiter walkthrough and require a verbal explanation of confirmation, approval, unknown, and verified.
top_findings.verification: The participant completes the journey without prompting and makes no false effect or outcome claim.

agreements: The Web slice is product-specific, quiet, evidence-first, and directly usable at 390 px and desktop widths.
Evidence, proposed interpretation, recruiter-confirmed state, approval, execution attempt, and observed readback remain distinct.
No_action, ambiguity, supersession, stale, unknown, offline, deleted, and revoked states avoid manufactured certainty or unsafe retry.
The accessibility skip-link defect was preserved as a before finding, fixed in implementation, regression-tested, and re-scanned to zero production axe violations.
No candidate contact or external write occurred; all data and effects were synthetic and localhost-bound.

disagreements.issue: Whether the completed Web slice is sufficient for an integrated release decision.

positions.position: The Web workflow passes with changes because the full recruiter decision and recovery path is direct.
The integrated journey fails because the intentional browser-capture boundary remains unproven.

disagreements.resolution: Keep the Web-authenticated slice score of 97 and independently keep the integrated journey score at 0.
disagreements.resolution_basis: An active evidence-safety veto is not averaged against downstream Web craft evidence.

veto_resolution.veto: XS-CAPTURE-01: the intentional Chrome capture and pre-Submit silence boundary is unproven.

adjudication.rationale: Round 2 directly closes the Web-specific 390 px journey, state breadth, reduced-motion, keyboard, skip target, automated accessibility, and production visual-evidence gaps. The proposed full-page artifact was rejected and replaced by inspected non-stitched viewport segments. These improvements justify the independent Web slice result but do not broaden authority to the Chrome extension or convert equivalent reflow into native zoom or automated AX into manual screen-reader proof. XS-CAPTURE-01 therefore remains active and blocks the integrated release gate.

next_tests.test: Run the exact frozen unpacked capture build in a policy-authorized visible Chrome profile.
next_tests.evidence_required: Visible invocation, temporary activeTab or selected-text scope, exact preview, pre-Submit network trace, explicit Submit, and backend receipt.
next_tests.pass_condition: XS-CAPTURE-01 resolves with one scoped synthetic capture and no pre-Submit transfer.

next_tests.test: Run native 200% zoom plus manual VoiceOver or NVDA traversal.
next_tests.evidence_required: Viewport recording, focus trace, spoken order, state announcements, and manual contrast disposition.
next_tests.pass_condition: All evidence and authority states remain readable, reachable, ordered, and truthfully announced.

next_tests.test: Run one uncoached first-use recruiter walkthrough.
next_tests.evidence_required: Task recording, completion time, hesitation notes, and participant paraphrase of authority transitions.
next_tests.pass_condition: The participant completes TS-CORE-01 without prompting or false effect and outcome claims.
